Integration notes: prototype integration uses Redwood SDK + streaming for chat UI. Current Hosted usage: 1.2M tokens/mo (trial), bursty: 600 rps peaks during product announcements. Cost sensitivity: medium-high; target 30-45% cost reduction vs hosted when moving to Dedicated (via batching/quant + routing).

Commercial: prefers annual commitment. Legal pushed for indemnity and explicit breach SLAs. Pricing convo: AE shared draft committed-capacity tiers (see drive deck).

POC ask: 3-week Dedicated POC, include canary rollout test (5% traffic), A/B of quantized model variant vs full FP model, and region-failover simulation (NA->EU and vice versa). Need rollback runbook and automated fallback to smaller model with preserved latency SLA.

Internal follow-ups: SE to validate KV cache warmup times; Eng to provide sample traffic trace (Claire to share).

requirements_summary: Workload: chat + doc-search + reranking for support flows. Targets: p50 latency < 120ms, p95 < 450ms for short chat contexts; sustained throughput 250-800 qps during peaks. Cost target: reduce per-token cost 30-45% on Dedicated via batching + quantization. Routing: need policy-based routing by geo and customer tier; automatic fallback to quantized model variant and lower-cost pool under contention. Compliance: SAML SSO, SOC2 audit evidence, KMS for customer keys, EU data residency for EU tenant data.
poc_plan:
3-week Dedicated POC scope:
- Week 0: infra prep, VPC peering test, KMS handshake, baseline metrics from Hosted usage.
- Week 1: deploy Dedicated pool in NA, deploy two model variants: full-precision (fp16) and quantized (int8). Implement canary route (5% traffic) to Dedicated fp16. Collect latency/cost baseline.
- Week 2: scale canary to 25%, enable automatic fallback policy: if p95 > 600ms or error_rate > 0.5% for 5m, route traffic to quantized variant or secondary region. Run simulated region failover NA->EU (traffic shift test).
- Week 3: run A/B comparing quantized vs fp, validate KV cache warmup, run rollback drill (intentional failure) to test automated rollback runbook. Deliver POC report with perf/cost deltas, recommended commit tier, and rollout playbook (canary percentages, rollback thresholds, monitoring hooks).
sales_play: Push for 12-month committed capacity with scaled entry tier + 30-day evaluation clause. Offer trial discount on first 3 months of Dedicated reserved instances. Include 'canary success' credit if integration milestones met. Finance approval path: procurement review in early-May (Q2).
